全新设计Listen模块 / Redesigned the Listen module from the ground up

简体中文
- 统一播放器状态、队列、进度与恢复逻辑，让浏览与播放切换更流畅
- 直播升级为Hush放空，支持内置频道、自定义频道、直播视频预览与播放状态同步
- 在线升级为Muse思绪，重做搜索、歌单、艺人、喜欢歌曲与队列体验，并接入更多桌面播放器能力
- 集成封面、纯文本歌词、同步歌词、罗马音/拼音显示，并让歌词高亮跟随播放进度
- 优化封面加载路径：前端直接加载远端图片，移除运行时本地任意图片代理注册，并收紧保留图片缓存的可信域名与体积边界
- 统一软件整体的设计语言、动态效果、文案格式与术语
- 添加繁体中文语言支持
- 补充播放、队列、歌词、封面缓存与前端存储测试

English
- Unified player state, queue, progress, and restoration logic for smoother browsing and playback transitions
- Upgraded Live to Hush, with built-in channels, custom channels, live video previews, and playback status sync
- Upgraded Online to Muse, with redesigned search, playlist, artist, liked songs, and queue experiences plus more desktop player capabilities
- Integrated artwork, plain lyrics, synced lyrics, romanization/pinyin display, and playback-driven lyric highlighting
- Improved artwork loading: the frontend now loads remote images directly, the runtime no longer registers an arbitrary local image proxy, and the remaining image cache is constrained by trusted hosts and response size
- Unified the overall design language, motion effects, copy formatting, and terminology
- Added Traditional Chinese language support
- Added coverage for playback, queue, lyrics, artwork cache, and frontend storage behavior

支持可选CDP浏览器 / Added selectable CDP browser support

简体中文
- 扩展 macOS、Windows 与 Linux 的 CDP 浏览器探测，支持 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Chromium、Vivaldi、Opera、Arc 与 Yandex
- 在设置常规页新增默认浏览器选择与手动刷新入口，刷新时显示按钮 loading 并复用最新候选列表
- 将默认浏览器配置接入连接器登录、站点打开与宠物画廊在线导入流程
- 持久化默认浏览器设置并补充 SQLite 迁移、Wails 接口、i18n 与前端类型
- 收紧 CDP 启动参数为本机调试地址并补充探测、偏好选择与服务注入测试

English
- Expanded macOS, Windows, and Linux CDP browser detection for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc, and Yandex
- Added the default browser selector and manual refresh button to General settings, with button loading state and refreshed candidate caching
- Wired the default browser setting into connector login, site opening, and pet gallery online import flows
- Persisted the default browser setting with SQLite migration, Wails APIs, i18n copy, and frontend contracts
- Bound remote debugging to localhost and added coverage for detection, preference selection, and service injection

修复默认浏览器DTO审计 / Fixed default browser DTO audit

简体中文
- 将 BrowserCandidate 改为基于生成的 browsercdp.Candidate 绑定类型派生，避免 settings transport contract 与生成 DTO 对齐规则冲突
- 重新通过 frontend audit、TypeScript 与开发构建校验

English
- Derived BrowserCandidate from the generated browsercdp.Candidate binding so settings transport contract auditing stays aligned with generated DTO rules
- Re-ran frontend audit, TypeScript, and development build checks

## 新增功能

- 新增「嗅探」功能，用于识别网页中的可下载资源。

- 新增「新建下载」中的嗅探下载方式，支持通过嗅探方式下载部分网站资源。

- 新增「嗅探台」，支持对任意网站进行资源嗅探，并选择特定文件进行后续操作。

- 新增播放器均衡器，支持 22 个预设方案，也支持自定义均衡器配置。仅 macOS 支持。

- 新增播放器频谱可视化，支持封面与频谱两种类型，共 8 种可视化样式。仅 macOS 支持。

## 修复问题

- 修复当前歌曲为播放队列最后一首时，无法点击「下一首」的问题。

- 修复歌曲包含多位歌手时，点击歌手可能被错误识别为同一人的问题。

- 修复「已结束」页面预览视频时，最大化与全屏按钮行为异常的问题。

- 修复「已结束」页面任务时间显示不正确的问题。

## 优化更新

- 优化「已结束」页面头部按钮，现在支持全选操作。

- 更新配置页面标签，新增「均衡器」标签，并移除「宠物」标签。

- 优化侧边栏迷你播放器按钮，现在支持加载状态显示。

- 更新连接模块，现在支持持久化完整的浏览器 Profile。

## 框架升级

- Wails 3 升级至 Alpha 95。

## New Features

- Added the new Sniff feature for detecting downloadable resources from web pages.

- Added a Sniff download method when creating a new download task, supporting resource downloads from selected websites through sniffing.

- Added Sniff Desk, allowing you to sniff resources from any website and select specific files for follow-up actions.

- Added a player equalizer with 22 presets and support for custom equalizer settings. macOS only.

- Added player spectrum visualization, including cover-based and spectrum-based modes with 8 visualization styles in total. macOS only.

## Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the Next button could not be clicked when the current track was the last item in the queue.

- Fixed an issue where multiple artists in a track could be incorrectly recognized as the same artist when clicked.

- Fixed incorrect maximize and fullscreen button behavior when previewing videos on the Completed page.

- Fixed incorrect task time display on the Completed page.

## Improvements

- Improved the header actions on the Completed page. Select All is now supported.

- Updated the Settings page tabs by adding Equalizer and removing Pets.

- Improved the sidebar mini player buttons with loading state support.

- Updated the Connection module to support persistent full browser profiles.

## Framework

- Upgraded Wails 3 to Alpha 95.
